messages:
Anna: Heads-up — planning to onboard harbinger-lite-4b into the model catalog tomorrow 09:30 PST. Need someone to own the deploy, one person on smoke checks, and rollback readiness verified.

Kevin: I can take the deploy window. Will be online from 09:15 for handoff. What's the canary percentage?

Anna: thanks Kevin. Start canary at 5% for 30m then 25% for another 30m if stable. Pin target is `harbinger-lite-4b:v1.2-quant`.

Maya: I'll run smoke. Can you share the smoke script and the quick dataset?

Anna: smoke script is in infra/smokes/harbinger-lite.sh — quick dataset link: https://internal/redwood-assets/harbinger/smoke-50.json. Commands: 
```bash
# smoke run (staging)
./harbinger-lite.sh --env staging --timeout 60
```

Samir: PR is open for the catalog entry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/482 — awaiting one more review (jules). Also added the pin metadata and perf note (p95 latency ~120ms on a10g).

Jules: taking review now. A few inline comments about memory config. Will push a small tweak by EOD.

Samir: @Kevin note — the deploy job will create alias `harbinger-lite-4b:stable` pointing at the new variant after canary. Rollback plan is to swap the alias back to previous variant and revert pin in catalog.

Anna: rollback commands (ops):
```bash
# swap alias back
redwood catalog alias set harbinger-lite-4b:stable=harbinger-lite-4b:v1.1
# revert pin (if needed)
redwood catalog pin update harbinger-lite-4b --version v1.1
```
Make sure you have `catalog-admin` role.

Kevin: got it. I have catalog-admin. I'll also run the `smoke` job after canary and post logs here.

Maya: I'll post smoke summary (pass/fail + top 3 failing prompts) and token counts. If anything >5% error we'll cut canary.

Jules: Reviewed and pushed changes — lowered max_batch_size in the registry entry to avoid OOMs.

deploy-bot: Deploy job scheduled by Kevin for 2026-03-20T09:30:00-08:00. Canary 5% -> 25%. Notifying oncall.

Anna: Perfect — thanks everyone. Kevin, please kick off 09:30, Maya will confirm smoke. I'll be around for rollback if we need it. If anything unexpected, escalate to #eng-oncall and ping me directly. :thumbsup:
